lesson.title: Tables and cooking conversations
lesson.title_ar: تطبيقات جدول الزراعة ومحادثة الطبخ الثنائية (طالب A / طالب B)

lines: 4.5 A Look at the table you completed in the last lesson. Use the information to test your partner. Ask questions like these:
How high are the Eastern mountain slopes?
Where will you find a subtropical climate?
B Make conversations. Listen to what your partner says and choose the right thing to say.
3 { Would you like to learn? | Who taught you? }
5 { What do you cook? | Why not? }
7 { What do you do if you're by yourself? | What's your favourite? }
9 { Do you catch your own fish? | You can't go every day. }
(WB p. 45) Pupil B - Your partner begins.
2 { Yes, I can. | No, I can't. }
6 { I don't have to. | Lots of things. Fish, lamb, rice, vegetables. }
8 { I go to a restaurant. | Fish. I love fish. }
10 { No. I haven't got a boat. | Why not? }
C Prepare some notes in your copybooks on the zone you live in. Be ready to tell the rest of the class about it if you are asked.

interactive_spot.label: مسارا الحوار المتشعبان في 4.5 B (مسار نعم أجيد الطبخ / مسار لا أجيد الطبخ)

simple_explain.html:
• المسار الأول (الإجابة بنعم — Yes, I can):
    1 Can you cook? → 2 Yes, I can. → 3 Who taught you? → 4 My aunt. → 5 What do you cook? → 6 Lots of things. Fish, lamb, rice, vegetables. → 7 What's your favourite? → 8 Fish. I love fish. → 9 Do you catch your own fish? → 10 No. I haven't got a boat.
  • المسار الثاني (الإجابة بلا — No, I can't):
    1 Can you cook? → 2 No, I can't. → 3 Would you like to learn? → 4 No, not really. → 5 Why not? → 6 I don't have to. → 7 What do you do if you're by yourself? → 8 I go to a restaurant. → 9 You can't go every day. → 10 Why not?

example.html: Listen & pick: Notice that Pupil B's odd-branch replies swap vertically across lines 4–10 so both partners must listen closely!

activities.prompt_literal: 4.5 A Look at the table you completed in the last lesson. Use the information to test your partner. Ask questions like these:
activities.prompt_ar: أسئلة وأجوبة الاختبار السريع من جدول 4.4 A (بما فيها الأسئلة الثلاثة المطبوعة):

items.question: How high are the Eastern mountain slopes?
items.explain_ar: من بيانات المنطقة الرابعة في الجدول وPB ص 27.

items.question: Where does cotton grow?
items.model_answer: In Zone 1 — the Tihamah on the Red Sea (0 to 300m).
items.explain_ar: يُزرع القطن والتمور والخضراوات والحبوب في السهل التهامي.

items.question: Where will you find a subtropical climate?
items.model_answer: In Zone 2 (Western mountain slopes) and Zone 4 (Eastern mountain slopes).
items.explain_ar: تتصف المنحدرات الغربية والشرقية بمناخ شبه مداري.

hints: يمكنك طرح أسئلة إضافية لزميلك مثل: Where is coffee grown? أو How high are the Central Highlands?

activities.prompt_literal: B Make conversations. Listen to what your partner says and choose the right thing to say. (Complete the key logical replies across both dialogue branches.)
activities.prompt_ar: أكمل الردّ المنطقي الموافق لقول شريكك في مسارَي المحادثة 4.5 B:
word_bank: No. I haven't got a boat.

items.prompt: 1 Partner says 'Yes, I can.' (Q2) → Turn 3 replies: ______
2 Partner says 'No, I can't.' (Q2) → Turn 3 asks: ______
3 Partner asks 'Why not?' after 'No, not really.' (Q5) → Turn 6 replies: ______
4 Partner asks 'What's your favourite?' (Q7) → Turn 8 replies: ______
5 Partner asks 'Do you catch your own fish?' (Q9) → Turn 10 replies: ______
answers: No. I haven't got a boat.

items.prompt: 6 Partner says 'You can't go every day.' (Q9) → Turn 10 replies: ______

hints: انتبه أن خيارات الطالب B من الخطوة 4 إلى 10 ليست بترتيب مسار واحد؛ بل يستلزم كل خيار المتابعة المنطقية لجملة شريكه.

activities.prompt_literal: C Prepare some notes in your copybooks on the zone you live in. Be ready to tell the rest of the class about it if you are asked.
activities.prompt_ar: أعدّ بطاقة ملاحظات منظمة في دفترك عن المنطقة التي تسكن فيها (الارتفاع والمناخ والمحاصيل):
activities.guidance_literal: Zone name & height → Summer & winter climate → Main crops & trees → Water source

steps.label_ar: 1) اسم المنطقة وارتفاعها عن سطح البحر
steps.placeholder: Zone: Central Highlands (Sana'a / Dhamar) — Height: about 2,200 to 2,400 metres.
Climate: moderate with warm days, summer rains, and cold winter nights.

steps.label_ar: 3) المحاصيل والفواكه التي تشتهر بها منطقتك
steps.placeholder: Vegetation: sorghum, wheat, grapes, apricots, peaches and figs grown on terraces and in wadi beds.

hints: اذكر اسم منطقتك الحقيقية واستعن بصفات المناخ والمحاصيل من درس 4.4.

questions.stem: In WB 4.5 B conversation #2, if Pupil B says 'Yes, I can.', which option must Pupil A choose in Turn 3?

options.why_wrong: هذا السؤال لا يُطرح إلا إذا أجاب الشريك: No, I can't.
هذه العبارة في الخطوة 5 ولا تناسب من قال إنّه يستطيع الطبخ.

options.text: Do you catch your own fish?
options.why_wrong: هذا السؤال في الخطوة 9 ولا يأتي إلا بعد أن يذكر السمك بوصفه طبقه المفضل.

hints: اقرأ خيارات الخطوة 3 تحت Pupil A في WB ص 44.
questions.explain: الردّ الطبيعي على Yes, I can (نعم أجيد الطبخ) هو سؤاله عمّن علّمه ذلك: Who taught you?

questions.stem: In WB 4.5 B Turn 7, if Pupil B replied 'I don't have to.' in Turn 6, what should Pupil A say next?

options.text: What do you do if you're by yourself?

options.why_wrong: يتبع هذا السؤال إجابة الأطعمة المتنوعة (Lots of things...) في المسار الأول.

options.text: Do you catch your own fish?
options.why_wrong: يتعلق بصيد السمك في الخطوة 9 لا بالطعام في عدم الطبخ.
هذا جواب للطالب B في الخطوة 4 بالمسار الأول.

hints: انظر إلى الردّ المتطابق في الخطوة 8 (I go to a restaurant).
questions.explain: يسأل ماذا تفعل حين تكون وحدك فيرد: أذهب إلى مطعم (I go to a restaurant).
